The '''Nath Goordi system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located in the [[Tennuutta sector/Legends|Tennuutta sector]] of the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]]. It contained the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Nath Goordi]].
